description: Market wisdom and trading rules to remember before placing orders

crude_oil.description: Crude Oil affects inflation and market sentiment
crude_oil.impact: High crude = negative for Indian markets

usdinr.impact: Strong dollar (USDINR up) = FII outflow = negative for NIFTY

us_10y_yield.description: US Bond yields affect global risk appetite
us_10y_yield.impact: Rising yields = risk off = negative for emerging markets

rules.alert: ⚠️ HOLIDAY REVERSAL RISK: Market may reverse after 3+ consecutive holidays. Be cautious with new positions.
rules.action: Consider reducing position size or wait for first 15-min candle to confirm direction

rules.alert: ⚠️ WEEKEND GAP: Significant gap up/down expected on Monday opening. Wait for gap filling before entering.
rules.action: Avoid first 30 minutes trading, wait for gap fill

rules.alert: 📅 EXPIRY DAY: High volatility expected. Option premiums will decay rapidly.
rules.action: Avoid buying OTM options, prefer selling or spread strategies

rules.alert: 🟢 RSI OVERSOLD ({}): Market may bounce back. Good opportunity for CE entries.
rules.action: Look for reversal signals, consider buying CE on confirmation

rules.alert: 🔴 RSI OVERBOUGHT ({}): Market may correct. Be cautious with CE positions.
rules.action: Consider booking profits in CE, look for PE entry on breakdown

rules.alert: 🟢🟢 RSI EXTREMELY OVERSOLD ({}): Strong bounce expected. High confidence CE setup.
rules.action: Strong buy signal for CE, but wait for candle confirmation

rules.alert: 🔴🔴 RSI EXTREMELY OVERBOUGHT ({}): Sharp correction likely. High confidence PE setup.
rules.action: Strong sell signal for PE, book CE profits immediately

rules.alert: ⚠️ MAX POSITIONS: You already have {} open positions. Adding more increases risk.
rules.action: Close losing positions before adding new ones

rules.alert: 🚨 DAILY LOSS LIMIT: Down {}% today. Stop trading for the day.
rules.action: Stop all trading, review positions tomorrow

rules.alert: ⚠️ CONSECUTIVE LOSSES: {} losses in a row. Take a break.
rules.action: Stop trading for 1 hour, review strategy

rules.alert: ⏰ FIRST 15 MINUTES: High volatility, avoid new entries.
rules.action: Wait for first 15-min candle to close before entering

rules.alert: ⏰ LUNCH HOUR: Low volume, false breakouts common.
rules.action: Avoid fresh entries, manage existing positions only

rules.alert: ⏰ LAST HOUR: Intraday positions should be closed.
rules.action: Square off intraday positions before 2:30 PM

rules.alert: 🚫 NO NEW TRADES: Market closing in 30 minutes.
rules.action: Do not enter any new positions

rules.alert: ⚠️ CAUTION: RSI is {} (overbought) but signal is CE. Risk of buying at top.
rules.action: Wait for RSI to cool down or look for PE signals instead

rules.alert: ⚠️ CAUTION: RSI is {} (oversold) but signal is PE. Risk of selling at bottom.
rules.action: Wait for RSI to rise or look for CE signals instead

rules.alert: ⚠️ LOW VOLUME: Volume is {}% of average. Signals may be weak.
rules.action: Wait for volume confirmation before entering

rules.alert: 📅 BUDGET DAY: Extreme volatility expected. Avoid trading.
rules.action: Stay out of market or trade very small positions

rules.alert: 📅 RBI POLICY DAY: Bank Nifty will be volatile. Avoid BN options.
rules.action: Avoid BANKNIFTY trades, NIFTY may also be affected

rules.alert: 🇺🇸 US MARKET: S&P moved {}% yesterday. Expect gap opening.
rules.action: Wait for opening direction, avoid pre-market trades

rules.alert: 🛢️ CRUDE SPIKE: Oil up {}% in 1 day. Indian markets may fall.
rules.action: Avoid CE positions, look for PE on breakdown. Oil sensitive stocks (ONGC, BPCL, IOC) will fall.

rules.alert: 🛢️ CRUDE CRASH: Oil down {}% in 1 day. Indian markets may rally.
rules.action: Good for CE entries, oil stocks may outperform

rules.alert: 🛢️ CRUDE HIGH: Oil above $90. Inflation fears, market negative.
rules.action: Reduce long positions, prefer PE for hedging

rules.alert: 🛢️ CRUDE LOW: Oil below $70. Bullish for Indian markets.
rules.action: Good environment for CE positions

rules.alert: 🛢️ CRUDE TREND: Oil up {}% in 7 days. Sustained negative pressure.
rules.action: Market may correct for few days, avoid fresh CE

rules.alert: 💵 RUPEE WEAKENING: INR down {}% vs Dollar. FII selling expected.
rules.action: FII outflow risk, avoid CE. Look for PE on NIFTY

rules.alert: 💵 RUPEE STRENGTHENING: INR up {}% vs Dollar. FII buying expected.
rules.action: FII inflow positive, good for CE entries

rules.alert: 💵 USDINR HIGH: Dollar above ₹85. Emerging markets under pressure.
rules.action: Reduce NIFTY longs, prefer defensive sectors

rules.alert: 💵 USDINR LOW: Dollar below ₹80. Risk-on sentiment, good for India.
rules.action: Positive for markets, look for CE opportunities

rules.alert: 💵 SHARP RUPEE FALL: INR crashed {}% today. Market may panic.
rules.action: High risk, avoid new positions, hedge existing

rules.alert: 📊 GIFT NIFTY: Gap up {}%. Expect strong opening.
rules.action: Wait for gap fill, don't chase opening

rules.alert: 📊 GIFT NIFTY: Gap down {}%. Weak opening expected.
rules.action: Look for PE after gap fill, avoid CE at open

rules.alert: 🌏 ASIAN MARKETS: Average down {}%. Global risk-off.
rules.action: Indian markets may follow, prefer PE

rules.alert: 📊 VIX HIGH: India VIX at {}. High volatility expected.
rules.action: Option premiums expensive, prefer selling strategies
